Gavin —

Here’s the teardown and the Q4 paid test plan, aimed at cheaper clicks for gifting and faster B2B conversions.

What to change on-page now (Corporate Gifting)
- First screen, no header: lead with “From £12/bottle”, “Delivery windows 1 Nov–20 Dec”, “Multi‑address via spreadsheet upload”. Keep “Prices exclude VAT and courier” visible.
- Primary CTA: “Get a price”. Secondary: “Download brochure (PDF)”. Add a “Download CSV template” link beside the CTA.
- Replace the long form start with a 3‑question quick start: (1) Number of recipients, (2) Budget per gift, (3) Delivery window. Output 2–3 package options; “Start your order” opens the full form with fields prefilled and CSV link.
- Keep the phone line prominent. If you can, swap “We aim to reply within 2–3 working days” for “We reply next business day.”

Wireframes (text outline)
- Mixed cases lander (paid‑social)
  Hero: “Mixed cases from £65, delivered UK‑wide.”
  Sub: “Thoughtful bottles from small producers.”
  Bullets: “Pick red, white or mixed” · “Free local delivery over £50 (Edinburgh)” · “No subscription required”.
  CTA: “Shop mixed cases”. Below: three case tiles (from‑price + 3 bullets), one short customer quote, delivery terms. No site header; slim footer.

- Corporate gifts lander (paid‑social/B2B)
  Hero: “Corporate wine gifts from £12/bottle.”
  Sub: “1 Nov–20 Dec delivery · UK‑wide · Multi‑address in one upload.”
  CTA: “Get a price” (opens the picker). Secondary: “Download brochure (PDF)”.
  Modules: 3‑question picker → options; “What’s included”; “How it works” (your 5 steps); FAQs; contact line.

Ads and testing
- For each lander: ship 3 concepts × 3 variants (product shot, case stack with ribbon, note‑card close‑up with price/dates in text). Retire any ad after ~3 weeks of falling click‑through; keep a fresh variant queued.
- If you use Meta, GEM (rolling out this week) is built for multi‑asset creative across Feed/Reels/Stories; keep price and delivery window in the first two lines. Add simple site‑visitor retargeting.
- Measure the thing you want: for cases = first order; for corporate = “Get a price started” + “Proposal submitted”. Give every variant distinct UTM content.

Why push now
- UK consumers say they’ll spend more on wine this Christmas (27% “significantly more”, 39.8% “slightly more”; 43.8% expect to buy more bottles). Source: Harpers, 12 Oct 2026.
